title: MAPS: Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning for Regulating Search Momentum in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29792v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving external knowledge. Recently, some RAG methods interleave reasoning and retrieval, enabling LLMs to progressively generate sub-queries and retrieve external knowledge. However, these methods may suffer from redundant or ineffective sub-queries and insufficiently diverse query exploration. Moreover, due to the tightly interleaved nature of reasoning and retrieval, it remains unclear how the evolving reasoning process influences query intent. To characterize the evolution of query intent during reasoning, we introduce search momentum, which captures the accumulated retrieval tendency induced by historical changes in generated sub-queries along the reasoning trajectory. translated_title: MAPS：面向检索增强生成中搜索动量调控的宏自适应并行推理
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过检索外部知识来提升大型语言模型（LLM）的性能。近来，一些RAG方法将推理与检索交错进行，使LLM能够逐步生成子查询并检索外部知识。然而，这些方法可能出现冗余或无效的子查询，以及查询探索多样性不足的问题。此外，由于推理与检索紧密交织，不断演变的推理过程如何影响查询意图仍不清晰。为了刻画推理过程中查询意图的演变，我们引入了“搜索动量”（search momentum）这一概念，它捕捉了沿着推理轨迹、由历史生成的子查询变化所引发的累积检索倾向。通过基于动量的分析，我们发现查询生成过程倾向于沿着已有的检索轨迹持续演化。基于这一观察……
tldr: 该论文提出“搜索动量”概念来刻画RAG中推理演变对查询意图的影响，发现查询生成易沿已有检索路径持续演化，并据此提出宏自适应并行推理方法MAPS来调控搜索动量，从而减少冗余子查询并提升查询探索的多样性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the concept of search momentum to characterize how evolving reasoning influences query intent in RAG, reveals that query generation tends to persist along existing retrieval trajectories, and proposes MAPS, a macro-adaptive parallel reasoning method that regulates search momentum to reduce redundant sub-queries and enhance query exploration diversity.
